title: Foundation Pre-A1–A2 Short Reading
description: Short, level-appropriate texts from Pre-A1 through the A2 starter stage. Reading evidence is separate from recognition and contextual application.

evidencePolicy.scope: short-reading-mcq-only; not CEFR certification or independent reading mastery

passages.title: A Name Card
passages.text: Lan is a new visitor at Green Office. She writes her name on a card. The card says: “Lan Nguyen”. She gives the card to the receptionist.

questions.prompt: Who is the visitor?
questions.rationale: The card gives the visitor’s name: Lan Nguyen.

questions.prompt: What does Lan give to the receptionist?
questions.rationale: The passage says she gives the card to the receptionist.

passages.title: A Morning Greeting
passages.text: It is 8:30 a.m. Minh enters the office. He sees Ms. Hoa near the door. Minh smiles and says, “Good morning, Ms. Hoa.” She says, “Good morning, Minh.”

questions.prompt: When does Minh enter the office?
questions.rationale: 8:30 a.m. is in the morning.

questions.prompt: What does Minh say?
questions.rationale: He greets Ms. Hoa with “Good morning”.

passages.title: About Mai
passages.text: Mai works in the sales team. She is 24 years old. Her desk is near the window. Mai likes her team because the people are friendly.

questions.prompt: Which team does Mai work in?
questions.rationale: The first sentence says Mai works in the sales team.

questions.prompt: What is the passage mainly about?
choices: Mai and her friendly sales team
questions.rationale: The passage gives basic information about Mai and says she likes her friendly team.

passages.title: Office Information
passages.text: The meeting room is on the second floor. It is next to the kitchen. The room is small but bright. There are six chairs and one table in the room.

questions.prompt: Where is the meeting room?
questions.rationale: The first sentence locates the room on the second floor.

questions.prompt: What can you understand about the meeting room?
choices: It is on the first floor
questions.rationale: There are six chairs and one table, so a small group can use the room.

passages.title: A Desk
passages.text: There is a computer on the desk. An orange notebook is beside the computer. The notebook belongs to Nam. He uses it to write his daily tasks.

questions.prompt: What is on the desk?
questions.rationale: The first sentence says there is a computer on the desk.

questions.prompt: What does Nam use the notebook for?
questions.rationale: The final sentence explains its purpose.

passages.title: Items for a Meeting
passages.text: The team needs three notebooks, two pens and four name cards for the meeting. Hoa puts the items in a blue box. She takes the box to Room 2 at 9:00.

questions.prompt: How many pens does the team need?
questions.rationale: The list says two pens.

questions.prompt: Where does Hoa take the box?
questions.rationale: The final sentence says she takes it to Room 2.

passages.title: The Office Café
passages.text: The office café opens at 7:00 a.m. every weekday. It serves coffee, tea and sandwiches. Many employees have breakfast there before work. The café closes at 5:00 p.m.

questions.prompt: When does the café open?
questions.rationale: The opening time is stated in the first sentence.

questions.prompt: Why do employees visit the café in the morning?
questions.rationale: The passage says many employees have breakfast there.

passages.title: A Delivery
passages.text: A delivery driver calls the office at 10:15. He has two packages for Ms. Linh. The receptionist asks him to wait in the lobby. Ms. Linh comes down five minutes later.

questions.prompt: Who are the packages for?
questions.rationale: The passage says the packages are for Ms. Linh.

questions.prompt: Where does the driver wait?
questions.rationale: The receptionist asks him to wait in the lobby.

passages.title: Finding the Printer
passages.text: The printer is between the meeting room and the manager’s office. A small table is in front of it. Paper is inside the cabinet under the table.

questions.prompt: Where is the printer?
questions.rationale: The first sentence gives the printer’s location.

questions.prompt: Where is the paper?
choices: In the cabinet under the table
questions.rationale: The last sentence states where the paper is kept.

passages.title: Tomorrow’s Training
passages.text: The staff training was on Monday. It finished at 4:00 p.m. The next session is on Friday at 9:00 a.m. Employees will learn how to use the new booking system.

questions.prompt: When did the previous training finish?
questions.rationale: The second sentence gives the previous session’s finish time.

questions.prompt: What is the main idea of the passage?
choices: A meeting room and its equipment
The previous session and the next training topic
questions.rationale: The passage tells when the previous training finished and what employees will learn in the next session.

passages.title: A Request for a Meeting Room
passages.text: The sales team needs a quiet place for a short call with a new customer. Mai asks the office assistant, “Could you reserve Room 3 for 2 p.m.?” The assistant checks the calendar and confirms that the room is available. The customer will join the call online, so the team also needs a screen and a speakerphone. Room 3 has both, and no other group has booked it. Mai receives the confirmation and shares the room number with her colleagues.

questions.prompt: What does Mai ask the assistant to do?
questions.rationale: Mai asks the assistant to reserve Room 3.

questions.prompt: When is the room needed?
questions.rationale: The request specifies 2 p.m.

questions.prompt: Why is Room 3 suitable for the sales team?
choices: It has a screen and a speakerphone.
It is next to the reception desk.
The customer asked to change the time.
Another group has already booked it.
questions.rationale: Đoạn văn cho biết khách hàng tham gia trực tuyến và Phòng 3 có cả màn hình lẫn loa ngoài; đây là lý do phòng phù hợp.

passages.title: Supplies for the Training
passages.text: The training office has many folders but only a little printer paper. The coordinator checks the supply cabinet before placing an order. She orders two boxes of paper and a few black pens because the next training session needs printed handouts. She does not order more folders because the storage cabinet is already full. The supplier confirms that the paper and pens will arrive before Thursday morning, so the training team can prepare the materials on time.

questions.prompt: What does the office need more of?
questions.rationale: The passage says there is only a little printer paper.

questions.prompt: Why are no more folders ordered?
questions.rationale: The cabinet is already full.

questions.prompt: What does the delivery information allow the training team to do?
choices: Return the folders to the supplier.
Move the session to next week.
questions.rationale: Vì giấy và bút sẽ đến trước sáng thứ Năm, nhóm có thể chuẩn bị tài liệu kịp buổi đào tạo.
questions.evidenceText: The supplier confirms that the paper and pens will arrive before Thursday morning, so the training team can prepare the materials on time.

passages.title: Choosing a Delivery Route
passages.text: The logistics team compared three routes to the northern branch. Route A is shorter, but it has heavy traffic in the afternoon. Route B is more reliable and has fewer road works, although it is slightly longer. Route C is the cheapest option, but delivery times change often. The team selects Route B because the customer needs the documents on time. The supervisor updates the delivery plan and asks the driver to check traffic before leaving.

questions.prompt: Which route is more reliable?
questions.rationale: The passage directly describes Route B as more reliable.

questions.prompt: Why does the team choose Route B?
choices: It has fewer road works and is more reliable
It has no traffic at any time
questions.rationale: Those are the reasons given for choosing Route B.

questions.prompt: What does the team’s choice suggest about the customer’s priority?
choices: The customer prefers the lowest price, even if delivery is late.
The customer wants the shortest route, regardless of traffic.
The customer values dependable, on-time delivery more than the cheapest option.
The customer has asked the supervisor to postpone the delivery.
questions.rationale: Đội chọn tuyến đáng tin cậy hơn dù không ngắn nhất hoặc rẻ nhất vì khách cần nhận tài liệu đúng hạn.
questions.evidenceText: The team selects Route B because the customer needs the documents on time.

passages.title: A Changed Appointment
passages.text: The purchasing manager met a supplier on Tuesday. They discussed a delayed order and agreed on a new delivery date. After the meeting, the manager sent a summary to the warehouse team so that staff could update the receiving plan. The supplier confirmed the new date by email that afternoon. On Wednesday, the warehouse supervisor changed the delivery calendar and informed the receiving staff. No further delay was reported.

questions.prompt: When did the manager meet the supplier?
questions.rationale: The first sentence says the meeting took place on Tuesday.

questions.prompt: What did the manager send after the meeting?
questions.rationale: The manager sent a summary to the warehouse team.

questions.prompt: What did the supplier do after the meeting?
choices: The supplier confirmed the new date by email.
questions.rationale: Đoạn văn cho biết nhà cung cấp đã xác nhận ngày giao hàng mới qua email vào chiều thứ Ba.

passages.title: Work at the Service Desk
passages.text: A new employee is working at the service desk this week while her colleague is on leave. She is answering phone calls, welcoming visitors and updating customer records. The supervisor is checking her work and helping with difficult requests. The employee is also learning how to use the booking system. Next week, when her colleague returns, she will go back to the sales office and continue her usual duties there.

questions.prompt: Why is the employee at the service desk this week?
questions.rationale: She is covering the desk while her colleague is on leave.

questions.prompt: What is the supervisor doing?
questions.rationale: The supervisor is checking her work and helping with requests.

questions.prompt: What will the new employee do next week?
choices: She will take another week of leave.
She will return to the sales office.
questions.rationale: Câu cuối nêu rõ tuần tới cô ấy sẽ trở lại văn phòng kinh doanh khi đồng nghiệp quay lại.

passages.title: Safety Rules for Visitors
passages.text: All visitors have to sign in at reception and wear a visitor badge. They must not enter the equipment room without an employee. Visitors do not have to bring their own safety vest because the reception desk keeps clean vests for them. Before leaving, visitors should return the badge to the security staff. These rules help the company know who is in the building and keep restricted areas safe.

questions.prompt: What must visitors do at reception?
choices: Sign in and wear a badge
questions.rationale: Visitors have to sign in and wear a visitor badge.

questions.prompt: Which statement is true about safety vests?
choices: Visitors are not allowed to wear one
questions.rationale: Reception keeps clean vests for visitors.

questions.prompt: What should visitors do before they leave the building?
choices: Return the visitor badge to security staff.
Sign out at the reception desk.
Leave the badge in the equipment room.
Give the badge to the maintenance team.
questions.rationale: Quy định nêu khách phải trả thẻ cho nhân viên an ninh trước khi rời đi.
questions.evidenceText: Before leaving, visitors should return the badge to the security staff.

passages.title: Directions to the Workshop
passages.text: The maintenance workshop is on the second floor, across from the storage office. Visitors should take the elevator, turn left, and walk past the staff kitchen. A sign for the workshop is beside the double doors. The workshop is not open to visitors without an appointment, so guests should contact the maintenance team before coming. The reception staff can help visitors find the correct office if they are unsure where to go.

questions.prompt: Where is the workshop?
questions.rationale: It is on the second floor, across from the storage office.

questions.prompt: What should visitors do after taking the elevator?
questions.rationale: The directions say to turn left after taking the elevator.

questions.prompt: When may a visitor enter the maintenance workshop?
choices: At any time during the day.
When the visitor has an appointment.
Only after visiting the staff kitchen.
Only when the storage office is open.
questions.rationale: Đoạn cuối về quy định cho biết xưởng không mở cho khách nếu không có lịch hẹn.

passages.title: An Invitation to Lunch
passages.text: The project leader invites the new members to lunch on Friday. The message says, “Would you like to join us at the café near the station?” Two employees accept the invitation. One employee cannot attend because she has a customer call at noon, so the leader offers to arrange another lunch next week. The leader asks everyone to reply by Wednesday so the café can prepare enough seats. The invitation is friendly and gives the team time to plan.

questions.prompt: What does the project leader invite the team to do?
questions.rationale: The message invites the members to lunch on Friday.

questions.prompt: Why can one employee not attend?
choices: She has another meeting next week
questions.rationale: She has a customer call at noon.

questions.prompt: Why does the leader ask everyone to reply by Wednesday?
choices: To let the café prepare enough seats.
To prepare a new project report.
questions.rationale: Đoạn văn nêu mục đích phản hồi trước thứ Tư là để quán chuẩn bị đủ chỗ ngồi.

passages.title: Steps for a Return
passages.text: To process a returned item, first check the order number on the receipt. Then inspect the product and record its condition. After that, prepare a return label and give it to the customer. Finally, update the inventory system so the warehouse knows the item is coming back. The staff member should complete every step before closing the request. If the receipt is missing, ask the customer for the order email before continuing.

questions.prompt: What should staff check first?
questions.rationale: The first step is to check the order number.

questions.prompt: What is the final step?
questions.rationale: Finally, staff update the inventory system.

questions.prompt: Why must the inventory system be updated?
choices: So the customer can pay again.
So the supplier can change the price.
So the order number can be deleted.
So the warehouse knows the item is returning.
questions.rationale: Đoạn văn nói rõ cập nhật hệ thống để kho biết mặt hàng đang được gửi trả.

passages.title: Plans for the Branch Visit
passages.text: The regional manager is going to visit the eastern branch next Wednesday. She is going to meet the local team and review the new service desk. The branch supervisor is preparing a short report about customer requests and common problems. The manager will send the travel details to the staff tomorrow. She also plans to visit the customer service area if there is enough time. The team is preparing the meeting room for her visit.

questions.prompt: When will the manager visit the branch?
questions.rationale: The visit is planned for next Wednesday.

questions.prompt: What is the supervisor preparing?
questions.rationale: The supervisor is preparing a short report about customer requests.

questions.prompt: Who is preparing the report about customer requests?
questions.rationale: Đoạn văn cho biết người giám sát chi nhánh đang chuẩn bị báo cáo ngắn về yêu cầu của khách hàng.

passages.title: Safety Inspection Update
passages.text: The facilities team has completed the safety inspection on the third floor. Two emergency lights have been replaced, and the exit signs have been checked. The supervisor has already sent the report to the building manager. The maintenance team has also recorded the work in its system. Staff have not received the final notice yet, so they are waiting before using the storage area again. The building manager will send the notice when the review is complete.

questions.prompt: What has the facilities team completed?
questions.rationale: Đoạn văn nêu rõ đội cơ sở vật chất đã hoàn thành đợt kiểm tra an toàn ở tầng ba.

questions.prompt: What has the supervisor already done?
choices: Sent the report to the building manager
questions.rationale: Câu thứ ba cho biết người giám sát đã gửi báo cáo cho quản lý tòa nhà.

questions.prompt: What are staff still waiting for?
questions.rationale: Đoạn văn nêu rõ nhân viên chưa nhận được thông báo cuối cùng và đang chờ thông báo đó.

passages.title: A New Order Procedure
passages.text: The new order procedure is now in place. Every purchase request is checked by a supervisor before it is approved. Last Friday, two urgent orders were delayed because a supplier form was incomplete. The forms were corrected, and both orders were shipped the next morning. The purchasing team has updated the checklist to prevent the same problem. Staff are asked to use the new form for every urgent order.

questions.prompt: Who checks each purchase request?
questions.rationale: Đoạn văn nêu rõ mỗi yêu cầu mua hàng được người giám sát kiểm tra trước khi phê duyệt.

questions.prompt: What happened to the incomplete forms?
questions.rationale: Sau khi phát hiện biểu mẫu chưa đầy đủ, các biểu mẫu đã được chỉnh sửa.

questions.prompt: When were the two delayed orders shipped?
choices: At the end of the month.
questions.rationale: Câu thứ tư cho biết sau khi biểu mẫu được chỉnh sửa, cả hai đơn hàng được gửi đi vào sáng hôm sau.

passages.title: Parking Permit Instructions
passages.text: Employees who need a parking permit should complete the online form. The security team will review each request and email a permit to the employee who submitted it. Vehicles that do not display a valid permit must use the visitor parking area. Employees should check the permit details before printing it and place it where security staff can see it. The updated policy is available on the company website, together with a short guide for new staff.

questions.prompt: Which employees should complete the online form?
choices: Employees who need a parking permit
questions.rationale: Câu đầu tiên xác định nhóm cần điền biểu mẫu là nhân viên cần thẻ đỗ xe.

questions.prompt: Where must vehicles without a valid permit park?
questions.rationale: Đoạn văn yêu cầu xe không có thẻ hợp lệ sử dụng khu vực đỗ xe dành cho khách.

questions.prompt: Where can employees read the updated parking policy?
questions.rationale: Câu cuối xác nhận chính sách đã cập nhật có trên website công ty.
